subject: SQLite Database reverting to earlier version (lost information)

messages.author: 32b56b82e6afcfce
messages.subject: SQLite Database reverting to earlier version (lost information)
parts: I have an application on shinyapps.io that contains a sqlite database.  When I logged on the see the record today, the database had reverted to the version that was originally uploaded with the application months ago. Is there anything I can do to get the lost information back?  I tried downloading the application bundle, but the only thing in the .gz directory was one file with no extension.  I'm not sure what to with this.  Thanks for any help.

messages.author: edbcc711cdbb3da8
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] SQLite Database reverting to earlier version (lost information)
parts:
Hi Jesse,
Presuming you haven't redeployed your application, the data is probably still there. We encourage everyone to think of storage on shinyapps.io as transient so in an ideal world you would have a way of backing up the data to a location you control and pulling it down on application start. 
When an application is deployed we actually place it on multiple servers for the sake of redundancy. When an application is not receiving any traffic it will "go to sleep" and the next time it is requested it may or may not start on the same server it was started on the last time.  You might be able to find your data by stopping the instance (in the application tab in the dashboard) and restarting it.   Hopefully it won't take more than 3 tries for you to find the instance that has the up to date data.  

We are looking at how we can make the pattern for persistent storage a little easier for everyone. 

Hope this helps. 
Tareef
